description: Land Title Settlement Department - Piyangiriya, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620005
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category.
